ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认自己无法定义时间时，他指出了时间最显著的特性之一：时间只有在特定的语境中才有意义。任何计时系统都是有效的，而每一种都因其用途而值得称赞。

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的逻辑结果：如果机器停止运转，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
